steps.content: It unlocked. Christina quickly checks the messages inside the phone. Among a pile of irrelevant high society life, she finds a text message worth noting.

<color=#fb9259>Tel: 043176889</color> 

Hi, Anania, remember me? Heh, I bet you do, your phone number hasn't changed. Neither have I. I'm a bit short on money recently, and you were the first one I thought of.
I still remember the <color=#fb9259>incident from ten years ago</color>, yes, at that little pond. It's our little secret, you wouldn't want me to lose it, would you?
<color=#fb9259>See you at 11 pm tomorrow at Central Park.</color>
If you don't come... something else might come to you.

23:12, August 6, N.F. 113

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: This is it! The victim rushed here because of this message and then met her fate. This is a message from the murderer!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Hmph, even left a phone number, what an arrogant culprit. Have no respect for lives and even declare war on us. I'll find out who you are right now!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Log into the system, apply to search the owner of this number... and information about the victim. The victim's name is... Anania...
Christina is fully focused on operating the security intranet, waiting for the response, completely unaware of a large shadow cast over her.

steps.speaker: Unpleasant Man
steps.content: ...Where did this brat come from? Who are you? Why did you barge into the crime scene?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Hmm? Crisp shirt but messy shoes and socks. Your wife must have carefully ironed that for you but ran out of time, and you just slipped on any shoes. And the only guy in the precinct who's been flaunting wedding gifts recently is...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: You must be Inspector Dole, the person in charge of this case! I am the <size=25><color=#7683a2>future</color></size> famous detective Christina, here to...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Ouuuch!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: My name is <color=#fb9259>Christina</color>, a freshman at the City Security Academy, doing a summer internship at the Eastside local security precinct. I'm assigned to assist with the investigation. I'm sorry I didn't immediately report to the person in charge of the scene.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: Who let a freshman intern on the scene? What if you spoil the evidence? Get lost!

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Inspector, actually she...
After hearing a few whispers, the inspector's expression changes from grumpy to surprised, then to indifferent and disgusted.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: So you know the higher-ups... Humph, got quite a strong backer. Can't you build your resume somewhere else?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Sir, I'm not here for my resume, I'm here for the truth. I can do it, just like believing in the everlasting existence of justice and light, please give me a chance!
As she speaks, her pocket vibrates, a message has arrived on her communication terminal. Christina pulls it out and looks at it, even more excited.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Look, I've found the first suspect! The owner of this suspicious phone number is a 48-year-old male called <color=#fb9259>Nathan</color>. The file says he's an Eastsider, but his past is very suspicious. Please allow me to keep investigating!
The girl's impassioned speech is met with silence. Eventually, the inspector sighs.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: I just can't get rid of you, can I? Fine, stay over there and watch, don't interfere with the investigation. Now, hand me the victim's phone.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Oh... Here, sir...
She hands over the phone with a regretful look on her face, moving as slowly as if she were holding a 100kg dumbbell, clearly reluctant. But just then...
The victim's phone suddenly rings, the incoming call display shows [043176889].

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: <size=28><color=#7683a2>Hand signal</color></size> Speaker...
Christina nods and presses the speaker button. A strange male voice comes from the other end of the phone.

steps.speaker: Strange Male Voice
steps.content: Hello there, rookie detective. Enjoying your little detective game?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: You're Nathan?! Show yourself, murderer!

steps.speaker: Strange Male Voice
steps.content: That's not quite right. Anania is still alive, the flowers are her life. They're still blooming brilliantly.

steps.speaker: Strange Male Voice
steps.content: Don't move, if you crush those flowers, you'll become the murderer.
Christina quickly looks down. Indeed, when she was hopping around nervously, she almost stepped into the pool.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...You jerk, just you wait, I'm checking the communication location now, and everyone who's making a call. I will search the entire city to find you!
...Wait.
How did he know <color=#fb9259>I was about to step on the flowers</color>?
Christina jumps up abruptly, her head swinging like a rattle drum, scanning the surroundings in a 360-degree panorama. A telescope, a disguise, anything will do.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>He can see me</color>! The murderer is nearby! Wherever he is, he can see me, so look for anyone making a call. Go quickly!

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: Keep it down, you're startling him! Over there!
The inspector raises his gun and fires a shot, aiming at a sheriff who is guarding the blockade. It's a good shot, but the sheriff deflects it with a wave of her hand.
The "sheriff" presses down her hat and turns to run towards the crowd, causing a wave of screams wherever she goes.

steps.speaker: Dole
steps.content: Of course it's a Sinner. Everyone listen to me, immediately—

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Leave it to me, I will catch the murderer and uncover the truth!

The inspector stretches out his hand to grab Christina, but is pulled by her brute strength, then he stumbles and falls to the ground. When he looks up again, the ginger girl has already run off like a runaway horse.
